scope: Additive seven-day/two-decision synthetic rehearsal after new information, integrated into Strategy with current forecast/commitments and optional fully confirmed event replay.

contract.decisions: Day 0 common action, then day 2 action conditioned only on elapsed fulfilled sales/receipts, retained physical/cash balances and explicitly assumed carrier ETA. Equal observations share one action; censored unserved demand, hidden scenario identity and future demand are not policy inputs.
contract.weight_basis: Authored finite-scenario assumptions; delayed branches retain conditional 0.6/0.4 uncertainty. No calibrated probability or validated carrier accuracy.
contract.bounded_menu: At most 72 first-action packages × six second-action combinations over three paths; path evaluation cap 6000. No stochastic sampler or MCTS.
contract.comparators: Retain existing commitments, fixed practical rule, bounded fixed two-epoch schedule, bounded observation-conditioned schedule. Both searches share paths, weights, objective and constraints; fixed comparator uses one literal second action across all paths.
contract.objective: Declared lexicographic continuity gap, unallocated service hours, unplanned invoice review, then weighted known conditional cost. Cost = new modeled cash commitments + holding + shortage − terminal inventory value; nonmonetized outcomes remain visible.
contract.conservation: Existing PO reserve charged once, unique one-time receipts, physical source/destination stock and cash residuals fail closed, irreversible elapsed commitments and cumulative fuel/staff/energy budgets retained. Only elapsed actual sales free storage; no reset or actual payment.
contract.extra_assumptions: Day-specific transport capacity and day-2 role windows are authored assumptions. Transfer is assumed usable on its decision day. Carrier ETA is accurate only within the tiny authored default set; later demand remains uncertain.
contract.client_safety: Detail opening performs no calculation; explicit run only, in-flight coalescing, input-signature invalidation/stale-response rejection, existing workflows retained as fallback. No saved choice, reservation, order, payment or provider call is created.

illustrative_results.distinct_day2_delayed_actions: Baseline day-5 ETA selects a 40-unit transfer only; confirmed four-day day-7 ETA selects transfer plus expedite. Both remaining later-demand paths share that observation-conditioned action.
illustrative_results.interpretation: Lower declared conditional cost has slightly higher weighted unmet demand, so this is not dominance or observed saving. Baseline and four-day replay figures have different assumptions and cannot be mixed. Staffing is planned, not demonstrated completion; elapsed outage remains.
